verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches the story indirectly. Agent Mode can "write documentation" (postman-docs-33), and the Public and Private API Networks are where "publishers share their APIs with the world" (postman-docs-44, postman-docs-55). Nothing describes auto-generating documentation from collections or specs, or publishing a hosted docs page. Missing for 10: documented generation of API docs from collections/specs, a documented docs publishing workflow (public/private docs URLs, custom domains), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
